title: Truman
image_role: 原创概念参考图；不是原片截图、历史档案照片、Harry S. Truman 或 Gary Sinise 的肖像
prompt: Create ONE original high-resolution cinematic concept image for the work-card of the 1995 American television biographical film Truman, directed by Frank Pierson. Scene inspired by its verified subject, the 1948 whistle-stop presidential election campaign (American Film Institute film listing; Harry S. Truman Presidential Library historical record). At a small Midwestern railroad station at blue-hour dusk in autumn 1948, a FICTIONAL middle-aged American politician viewed only from behind stands on the rear observation platform of a period campaign train, speaking toward a modest crowd of ordinary townspeople in coats and hats. Warm practical lanterns and train windows against cool deep-blue sky, historically plausible train and clothing, understated 1990s film-drama color palette, strong 16:9 composition, crisp detailed full-size image with foreground crowd, midground train platform, background station, no exaggerated patriotic spectacle. This is an original interpretation, NOT an authentic film frame, archival photo, poster, or portrait of Harry Truman, Gary Sinise, or any real person. Avoid recognizable facial likenesses; no readable signs, candidate names, typography, slogans, logos, watermark, borders, split panels, or collage.
